summary: Reads four bytes from a buffered stream (one byte per call to sub_534E70) and packs them into a 32-bit little-endian integer. If the fourth byte read returns -1 (EOF), sets the error field this[14] (offset 0x38) to -3. Returns the packed 32-bit value even on a partial/EOF read. Used by BufferedFileReader (0x00534F90) on the per-frame path.

operations.description: Read byte 1 of the stream via sub_534E70(this) and store as v2.
Read byte 2 of the stream via sub_534E70(this) and store as the second byte.
Read byte 3 of the stream via sub_534E70(this) and store as the third byte.
Read byte 4 of the stream via sub_534E70(this) and store as v5.
Pack the four bytes into a 32-bit little-endian value: v2 + (v3 << 8) + (v4 << 16) + (v5 << 24).
Guard: if the fourth byte read (v5) equals -1 (EOF), set the error code.
Write error code -3 into this[14] (dword field at offset 0x38) when the fourth byte read hit EOF.
Return the packed 32-bit value (the last byte may be an EOF marker).
Called by BufferedFileReader (0x00534F90) as part of buffered binary stream reads.
